Format: 51 .ogg files in Audio/
Covers: footsteps (footstep00-09), doors (doorOpen_1-2, doorClose_1-4, creak1-3,
  metalLatch), cloth/belt rustle, book open/close/flip/place, coin/handle-coins
  jingle, knife/metal sounds. Directly useful for: player footsteps, room/door
  transitions, the key pickup sound (handleCoins or metalClick), book/desk
  interactions in labs and the library.
Does not cover: UI clicks (see kenney-ui-audio) or music.
